name: s81dv_rly_276_sn-dv4-COMMIT
purpose: S81-DV 276-b straight lane relay station dsfd_dvrly_276_SN (S in / N out, ck+rs E), recipe 4 flop-first

bench.name: lint
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; dsfd_dvrly_276_SN u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/dsrom_sys/s81_glue/ot_s81_rly.sv rtl/dsrom_sys/s81_glue/dsfd_rly_masters_dv276.sv && echo lint-ok

calibrate.reason: ref_tile: boundary referenced in-run to the propagated tree (io_ref_skew.sdc), as the Qwen die masters

route.cmd: export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; HM=0.03 OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/ref_tile/s81dv_rly_276_sn/signoff_ffrepair.sdc' SRC={SRC} OT_PIN_GROUP_MAX=32 bash tools/ref_tile/ref_route.sh physical/ref_tile/s81dv_rly_276_sn/kit.env {LABEL} {RUN}/routes

collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/ref_tile/ref_tile.py export --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --kit physical/ref_tile/s81dv_rly_276_sn --out {RUN}/record/views/dsfd_dvrly_276_SN  > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1

budget.reason: ref_tile: boundary budget 0.2 T applied in-run

structural_change: S81-DV p4c-lanes (claude/s81dv-1016 d5a2a52ca, S-ELEM 10-17): straight 276-b lane station S->N, one register stage (ot_s81_rly W=276 RSREG=1, rs1s56 form), ck = the lane's forwarded clock on E with rs; recipe 4 flop-first, hold_budget die (no inhold/outhold pads; boundary hold is the die's). Outline from 276 pins at 2 tracks on the data faces (spread_face_pins margin 2.16). 0 cycles vs the planned one stage per 405-um hop.
